objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle within the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document within the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type assigned upon creation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow or lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented upon revisions.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated date until which the document remains valid, derived from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable time period for how long an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies associated with or relevant to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas where the document applies.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person responsible for creating and signing the document in the first workflow step.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with change rights on the document, no relevance in release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document for distribution.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling read access to the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope information that can be printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A non-controlled document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment (Equippment) that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document's release.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authorized users to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history directly.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document and archive it along with its attachments, processed through a workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created in a designated folder and processed through a workflow.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users in the system used for assigning authorizations, reader access, and distribution list membership.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and permissions for document management activities.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the user, such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: The language in which the user logs in, determining which language version of documents is displayed.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups and persons who are informed about document releases, supporting email notification and acknowledgement distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: either distribution by email or distribution for acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of workflow tasks during the release process.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that manages the steps of document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity that can be linked to documents through the database integration.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and management.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents through the database integration.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation report providing filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The specific type of report, such as Status Report, Search for Documents, or Status Report for Acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view providing relevant document information, populated based on distribution group assignments.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A distinct organizational client within a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A user creates a new document object in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: A user edits the content of a document using the implemented editing client which opens the document in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: A user maintains or modifies the metadata and attributes of a document through the properties editing interface.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts a saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: An author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_document_creation
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness as part of the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document for distribution to readers as the final step of the release workflow.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The system automatically publishes a released document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: The system creates a new editing version of a released document when revisions or triggering changes occur.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An author adds an additional information object to a document, which is not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: An author releases and publishes additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An author directly deletes an additional information object from a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An author adds a controlled attachment (Equippment) to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: A user modifies an existing controlled attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A user with author rights creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, triggering notification to the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically generates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser or workflow participants confirm the extended validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a released document and archive it.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The workflow completes the override process, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: A user assigns user groups or persons to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: send_release_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users on the distribution list when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system sends email requests to users on the acknowledgement distribution list to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow-supported acknowledgement process.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A reviewer checks the translated version of a document for correctness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the translated language version of a document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations (read and change rights) are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes a document after its archive duration has expired.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A user generates a role-specific evaluation report with selected parameters and criteria.

o2o.description: A document can reference other documents through the references attribute.
A document can be linked to organizational units through database integration.
A document can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to risks through database integration.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new documents.
A document can have additional information objects attached to it.
A document can have controlled attachments (Equippments) that are subject to versioning and released with the main document.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed in it.
Each document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons to be informed about releases.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to invalidate it.
A request for reactivation references the specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members are informed about document releases.
A distribution list can contain individual persons who are informed about document releases.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them specific authorizations and roles.
In a multi-client system, a document can be specified as visible or not in specific clients.
Dashboards are populated with documents based on the user's distribution group assignments.
